messages:
Ben Patel: quick sync — we need to lock a time for the post-incident review related to last night's eu-west-1 paging storm. customer impact: elevated 5xxs on hosted API between 02:14-02:42 UTC; partial mitigation via fallback routing. can someone facilitate? i'm tied up with handoffs today.
incident-bot: Incident summary: INCIDENT-2026-11-03-EUW-PAGING. Pages triggered: 14. Severity: sev2. Affected service: hosted-api (eu-west-1). Automatically captured logs: /var/log/infra/paging/2026-11-03.log.
Priya Singh: available to facilitate if no one else volunteers. i can do notes and actions too. prefer morning windows CET (08:00-11:00) or 16:00-18:00 CET.
Marco Ruiz: thanks Priya — can you take it? i can join as SME for routing & fallback.
Emma Zhao: i can take the capture if Priya wants to facilitate, I'm happy to own the action tracker. but if Priya wants full facilitation + notes i'm fine to just be SME.
Alice Chen: fyi customer ops asked for an executive summary for the impacted customers (payments & analytics workloads). we should assign someone to draft that after the review.
Ben Patel: Priya — please go ahead and facilitate. assign Emma to capture action items and produce the exec summary draft. can we do tomorrow 09:30 CET (08:30 UTC)?
Priya Singh: 09:30 CET works for me. i'll send calendar invite and include runbook + timeline. agenda suggestion: 1) timeline & impact 2) root cause hypotheses 3) remediation & short-term fixes 4) owners & due dates 5) customer comms plan. any additions?
Marco Ruiz: add a quick perf reproduce checklist — want to validate the KV cache warm-up theory.
Emma Zhao: noted. i'll prepare the action tracker template and link to a Google sheet in the invite. i'll draft the exec summary after the meeting and share in #customer-success for review.
Ops Pager: Paging log snippet (excerpt):
```
02:14:18 ERROR upstream 502 backend-overloaded, qlen=64
02:17:05 WARN fallback engaged -> routing to eu-west-2
02:28:42 INFO degraded P95 latency 1200ms
```
Emma Zhao: assigning owners now: A1) fallback autoscale tuning -> Marco Ruiz (due 2026-11-10) A2) prefix cache priming script -> Eng-runtime (owner TBD) A3) customer exec summary -> Emma Zhao (draft due 2026-11-05) A4) post-deploy SLO check -> Alice Chen (due 2026-11-06). i'll add these to the sheet and tag owners.
Ben Patel: Marco, can you confirm if you need infra help for A1? also we should decide whether to widen fallback window or tighten router thresholds.
Marco Ruiz: i'll triage tomorrow before the review and leave a note. likely need a small infra window to test scaling; would like 30m.
Priya Singh: invite sent to attendees: Priya Singh, Marco Ruiz, Emma Zhao, Ben Patel, Alice Chen, ops-oncall. meeting link + pre-read: timeline + logs attached. calendar event 2026-11-04 09:30 CET (08:30 UTC).
Ben Patel: perfect. two quick asks before meeting: 1) people bring one slide for evidence if you have it (heap/metrics/logs) 2) mark any action you might own as tentative in the tracker so we can finalize in session.
Alice Chen: noted — i'll put together customer impact bullet points and SLO delta numbers for the timeline.
Emma Zhao: i'll post the tracker link here: https://docs.google.com/sheets/d/1example (edit access for attendees).
Priya Singh: thanks all. facilitator checklist I'll run through: start on time, review timeline, call out mitigations, confirm owners and deadlines in the sheet, and follow up with the exec summary. if anyone can't make it, please @Priya or update the sheet. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
Ben Patel: thanks team. tagging incident-bot to auto-generate the post-incident page after we mark actions done. incident-bot, can you create a stub wiki page once meeting ends?
incident-bot: acknowledged. Will create wiki stub /incidents/INC-2026-11-03-euw-paging/post-review-draft when meeting is marked complete.
Emma Zhao: last message: if folks want to review logs ahead, full logs are in the incident channel pinned files and in s3://rwinf-logs/2026/11/03/euw-paging.log. see you all tomorrow. :wave:
